classification: descriptive single-revision representative CRUD baseline; no speedup or completion claim

normal.order: matrix order then reverse matrix order

allocator.order: matrix order then reverse matrix order

cache: warm generated in-memory sources except explicit source path recorded per case; global filesystem setting does not prove filesystem work
process_scope: fresh process per selector per repeat; warmups and samples share that process
isolation: serialized against all task-owned builds/tests/profiling/analysis workloads; shared KVM background uncontrolled
statistics: exact median and nearest rank p95/p99 per report; both repeats and >5percent drift flags retained; no causal cross-selector or cross-revision ranking claim
next_action: profile expensive supported operations after validation; do not infer hot library code from setup-heavy whole-process profiles
